text: flexseqs provide list-like operations including indexed named element access, push/pop/peek either end double-ended queue behavior, insertion, splitting, concatenation. priority_queues associate items priority values provide min max peek/pop priority fast insertion. ordered_sequences associate items key values keep elements sorted order key. may similarly inserted/popped/peeked key value well position. Core functions implemented C++ (via Rcpp) speed, matching pure-R reference implementations using lambda.r syntax match paper. Finally, developer API supports addition custom structures via combinations monoids measures; see vignettes details. Hinze, R. Paterson, R. (2006), Finger trees: simple general-purpose data structure.
